teaser.text: Broadcom sells the hidden machinery of modern computing: chips that move and process data, and software that keeps organizations running. To understand its business, follow a dollar from a customer’s design or subscription through manufacturing, support, collection and the risks that remain.

stock.title: Broadcom stock forecast
stock.meta_description: Broadcom stock forecast: scenarios, cash generation, key risks and the valuation behind the October 2029 outlook.
stock.opening: Broadcom's weighted scenario reaches $548.37 in October 2029. It hinges on AI shipments becoming collected cash and software customers renewing.
stock.closing: The full Broadcom memo also explains Broadcom's business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: Where could Broadcom's shares be by October 2029?

paragraphs.text: Broadcom’s probability-weighted price is $554.13 in October 2027, implying a 55% return with dividends. It rises to $580.56 in October 2028, implying a 63% return. By October 2029, it is $548.37, still a 55% return.
The final-date range is wide: $281.84 in the bear case to $644.42 in the bull case. The comparison begins from today’s price of $360.14.

blocks.heading: What has to go right, and what could go wrong for Broadcom?

paragraphs.text: The bear case falls to 28.0% growth in FY2027 and then 10.0% and 5.0%, as deployments slip, customers redesign programmes and VMware renewals weaken. The bull case uses 63.0% growth in FY2027, 85.0% in FY2028 and 45.0% in FY2029, assuming repeat accelerator generations and networking attach exceed the stated plan.

Cash conversion remains below the company’s earlier peak. Base after-stock-pay free-cash-flow margin is 30% in FY2026 and declines to 27% by FY2029. The FY2025 actual was 30.3%, while stock pay was $7,568 million. Bear margins fall from 25% to 19%; bull margins rise from 31% to 34%. The gap reflects inventory, supplier commitments and compensation: Q4 non-GAAP operating-margin guidance is 66.0%, but stock pay is excluded from that measure. Purchase commitments were $126,821 million, with potential rack lease exposure of approximately $29 billion.

blocks.heading: How much cash does Broadcom really make?

paragraphs.text: Operating cash reached $27,537 million in FY2025. Capital spending was $623 million, leaving free cash flow of $26,914 million, matching Broadcom’s own measure. The low capital spending reflects its largely fabless model: outside manufacturers make the chips, while Broadcom funds design, manufacturing purchases and software development.

dividend.title: Broadcom dividend: cash cover and yield
dividend.meta_description: Broadcom pays a quarterly dividend, and real free cash flow after stock pay covers it; see the yield, history and risks.
dividend.opening: Broadcom pays $0.65 every quarter, or $2.60 in FY2026. Broadcom generated $19,346 million of real free cash flow after stock pay, or $3.99 per diluted share, so its cash covered the dividend.
dividend.closing: The full Broadcom memo also answers how Broadcom makes money, compares Broadcom with rivals, examines Broadcom’s management, and tests Broadcom’s risks.

blocks.heading: How much does Broadcom pay its shareholders?

paragraphs.text: The dividend holds at $2.60 in FY2026 because the declared quarterly rate is $0.65. The base case then assumes 10% annual increases, while bear and bull growth is 5% and 12%. Strong free cash flow supports the base, but investment and financing commitments limit certainty.

blocks.heading: Is Broadcom's dividend covered by its cash?

paragraphs.text: Stock compensation requires an economic adjustment. Broadcom recorded $7,568 million of stock-based compensation in FY2025 and added it back because it was not a cash expense. Deducting it leaves $19,346 million of free cash flow after stock pay. On that basis, cash flow was $3.99 per diluted share rather than $5.55. The deduction is analytical, but it recognizes the value transferred from existing shareholders to employees.

Dividends and buybacks consumed most available cash in the ordinary years. A buyback can benefit continuing owners when the company buys shares below their future value, but its size alone proves nothing, especially when stock awards can replace some of the retired shares.

blocks.heading: What is Broadcom's dividend yield against its price?

paragraphs.text: Revenue rose from $27,450 million in FY2021 to $63,887 million in FY2025. Operating margin rebounded to 39.9% from 26.1%, while diluted EPS rose to $4.77 from $1.29; FY2024 included VMware acquisition effects and an unusual tax charge. Broadcom’s free cash flow after stock pay was $3.99 per share versus $5.55 before stock pay. The valuation turns on a 1.6% free-cash-flow yield and 0.7% dividend yield.

earnings.title: Broadcom earnings: guidance and what to watch
earnings.meta_description: Broadcom's December 9, 2026 results will test AI revenue, adjusted profitability, shipments and customer cash.
earnings.opening: Broadcom's next results are expected on December 9, 2026. Watch whether Broadcom's AI shipments become customer cash.
earnings.closing: The full Broadcom memo also answers questions about Broadcom's business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: What has Broadcom guided for the next quarter?

paragraphs.text: For the quarter ending in November 2026, management guided to revenue of $34,800 million, including $21,700 million from AI semiconductors. These include custom accelerators, chips designed for one customer’s particular work, and networking chips, which move data among many processors. AI would therefore provide roughly three-fifths of quarterly sales.

Management also guided to a 66.0% non-GAAP operating margin. Operating income is revenue minus operating costs, before interest and taxes. Non-GAAP means Broadcom excludes selected items, including stock-based compensation and acquisition-related amortization. So 66 cents of adjusted operating income per dollar of revenue is not 66 cents of cash available to spend.

blocks.heading: Did Broadcom keep its past revenue promise?

paragraphs.text: Management also delivered an operating promise: it forecast approximately US$17.4 billion of fourth-quarter revenue and later reported US$18,015 million. Compensation nevertheless received only about 66.4% support. Broadcom says Tan’s existing awards cover annual equity opportunities through fiscal 2030. Investors should therefore judge the next promise by what AI growth leaves behind after pay: lasting cash and value per share.

blocks.heading: What were Broadcom's last eight quarters of revenue and profit?

paragraphs.text: Revenue reached $29,591 million, up 85.5% from the comparable quarter. The broader sequence also climbed from $14,054 million in November 2024 to $18,015 million in November 2025 and then higher through FY2026. This looks like sustained acceleration rather than a single rebound.

Operating income rose 171.0%, and operating margin reached 53.9%. Gross margin was 69.1%, slightly below May’s 69.5%, yet operating economics still strengthened. Net income reached $13,088 million, while diluted EPS was $2.68.
